name: category_revenue_rollup
description: Join-heavy revenue rollup by event category over events, shows, and order_items.
sql: SELECT e.category, COUNT(*) AS line_count, SUM(oi.line_total) AS gross_revenue FROM events e JOIN shows s ON s.event_id = e.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.show_id = s.id GROUP BY e.category ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC, e.category;

name: city_ticket_pressure
description: Operational ticket-demand dashboard by city over venues, events, shows, and tickets.
sql: SELECT v.city, COUNT(*) AS issued_tickets FROM venues v JOIN events e ON e.venue_id = v.id JOIN shows s ON s.event_id = e.id JOIN tickets t ON t.show_id = s.id WHERE t.ticket_status = 'issued' GROUP BY v.city ORDER BY issued_tickets DESC, v.city;

name: customer_tier_revenue
description: Read-heavy customer rollup across customers, accounts, and orders.
sql: SELECT c.tier, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.grand_total) AS gross_revenue FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id JOIN orders o ON o.account_id = a.id WHERE o.order_status = 'placed' GROUP BY c.tier ORDER BY gross_revenue DESC, c.tier;

name: promotion_discount_rollup
description: LEFT JOIN reporting query that measures order volume and discount usage by promotion activity.
sql: SELECT p.active, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, SUM(o.discount_total) AS total_discount FROM promotions p LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.promo_id = p.id GROUP BY p.active ORDER BY p.active;

name: audit_day_activity
description: High-row-count dashboard query over audit_events for daily activity trends.
sql: SELECT event_day, event_kind, COUNT(*) AS activity_count FROM audit_events GROUP BY event_day, event_kind ORDER BY event_day, event_kind LIMIT 60;
